title: Same JavaScript surface from Kotlin/JS and Rust/WASM
description: Engineering consequence of Stakeholder directive: transpile targets and API-first; jco: JavaScript toolchain for WebAssembly components.

statements.label: Same JavaScript surface from Kotlin/JS and Rust/WASM
statements.requirement: The Node.js packages built from Kotlin/JS and from the Rust WebAssembly component SHALL expose the same TypeScript surface: the declarations jco generates from the WIT (api/generated/ts). The Kotlin/JS declarations SHALL type-check against it.

successCriteria.criterion: One TypeScript conformance suite for both Node packages (req:stt-tst-007) passes.
